name: ImageSVG for ChatGPT
tagline: Turn existing logos and icons into editable SVG in ChatGPT.
description: ImageSVG for ChatGPT is an interactive app for turning existing PNG or JPG artwork into editable vector paths. It is useful when a brand logo or product icon needs to scale to multiple sizes, or when an illustration needs to be recolored or reused in print and digital design. Users open the ImageSVG panel in ChatGPT, choose an image, start the conversion and compare the resulting SVG with the original before downloading. The app traces existing artwork and requires user interaction in the panel. A signed-in ImageSVG account includes 3 free conversions per UTC day and 15 per month, with optional paid plans for higher usage.
